<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>Directions for the Completion of the Subscription Documents </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">(for Natural Persons/Individual Subscribers, IRAs, HSAs and Living Trusts) </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The attached Subscription Agreement (including the Annexes and Exhibits attached thereto, the &#8220;<B><I>Subscription
Documents</I></B>&#8221;) relates to the offering by TCW Specialty Lending LLC (the &#8220;<B><I>Fund</I></B>&#8221;) to you (the &#8220;<B><I>Subscriber</I></B>&#8221;) of common limited liability company units (&#8220;<B><I>Units</I></B>&#8221;)
in the Fund. Capitalized terms not defined in these directions shall have the meanings given to them in the Subscription Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Subscription Documents that are missing requested information or signatures will not be considered for acceptance unless and until such
information or signatures are provided. Subscribers may be required to furnish other or additional documentation evidencing the authority to invest in the Fund. In addition, the Fund may require additional information from a subscriber in order to
verify its &#8220;accredited investor&#8221; status and other representations made in the Subscription Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>PLEASE TYPE OR USE
LEGIBLE BLOCK CAPITALS WHEN COMPLETING THE SUBSCRIPTION DOCUMENTS. </B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>1.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B></B><B><U>Subscriber Information</U></B>. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>1.1.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B></B>Fill in the name of the Subscriber and the Commitment on the cover page hereof. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>1.2.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B></B>All Subscribers must complete the enclosed Subscriber Questionnaire (Annex I). </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>1.3.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B></B>Fill in the name of the Subscriber and the date (print name and title of authorized signatory) of the
Subscription Agreement and sign in the blank provided. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>1.4.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B></B>Carefully review the Electronic Communication and Signature Authorization (Annex II).
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>1.5.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B></B>If you are an existing Unitholder and you wish to increase your capital commitment, please complete the
Additional Commitment Form (Annex III). </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>2.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B></B><B><U>Required IRS Certifications for all Subscribers.</U></B> Fill in, sign (print name and title of
authorized signatory, if applicable) and date an IRS Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-9</FONT> if you are a Subscriber that is a &#8220;United States person&#8221; (as defined in the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the
&#8220;<B><I>Code</I></B>&#8221;)) (a &#8220;<B><I>U.S. Subscriber</I></B>&#8221;). If you are a Subscriber that is not a &#8220;United States person&#8221; (as defined in the Code) (a &#8220;<B><I>Foreign Subscriber</I></B>&#8221;), please provide
a signed and completed appropriate Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-8.</FONT> </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>3.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B></B>If the Adviser accepts your subscription (in whole or in part), the Adviser will countersign the
Subscription Agreement and deliver a copy of it to you at the address you provide in the Subscription Documents. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Please
note that the attached Subscription Documents contain a power of attorney which enables the Adviser to execute documents relating to the Subscriber&#8217;s investments in the Fund on behalf of the Subscriber. </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

Lending LLC </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">c/o TCW Asset Management Company LLC </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">515 South

</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The undersigned subscriber (the &#8220;<B><I>Subscriber</I></B>&#8221;) understands that TCW Specialty Lending LLC, a Delaware limited
liability company, (&#8220;<B><I>the </I></B><B><I>Fund</I></B>&#8221;) has been formed for the purpose of investing in various types of investments as described in the registration statement on Form 10, as may be amended, of the Fund (the
&#8220;<B><I>Registration Statement</I></B>&#8221;), the Private Placement Memorandum, as may be amended (the &#8220;PPM&#8221;), the Amended and Restated Limited Liability Company Agreement that will govern the Fund from and after the Closing, as
amended, in the form previously furnished to you (together with the organizational documents of any parallel funds, being herein referred to as the &#8220;<B><I>LLC Agreement</I></B>&#8221;), as such documents may be amended, amended and restated or
supplemented from time to time (together with the Registration Statement and the PPM, the &#8220;Offering Documents&#8221;). The Subscriber further understands that the Fund is offering to the Subscriber the opportunity to subscribe for common
limited liability company units in the Fund (&#8220;<B><I>Units</I></B>&#8221;). As used in this agreement, the term &#8220;<B><I>Adviser</I></B>&#8221; shall refer to TCW Asset Management Company LLC, a Delaware limited liability company.
Capitalized terms used in this Subscription Agreement (this &#8220;<B><I>Subscription Agreement</I></B>&#8221;) without definition will have the meanings given in the LLC Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

equal to the net asset value (&#8220;<B><I>NAV</I></B>&#8221;) that it hereby subscribes for the commitment in the amount set forth above (the &#8220;<B><I>Commitment</I></B>&#8221;), subject to the below Section&nbsp;11.13, on the terms described
or appearing in the Offering Documents (it being understood that if the subscription is partially accepted, the Fund will amend this Subscription Agreement to reduce the above number of Units and corresponding Commitment to reflect the number of
Units to be issued to the Subscriber). Subject to the terms of this Subscription Agreement and of the LLC Agreement, the Subscriber&#8217;s obligation to pay for the Units it is purchasing hereunder shall be unconditional, complete and binding upon
the completion of the Closing (as defined below), provided, however, that for the convenience of the Fund, the Subscriber&#8217;s Commitment shall be payable in capital contributions as provided in Article 6 of the LLC Agreement. The Subscriber
agrees to become a unitholder and to be bound by the terms and provisions of the LLC Agreement in the final form provided to the Subscriber and this Subscription Agreement, and the Subscriber and the Adviser agree that the Subscriber shall be
admitted as a unitholder, in each case on the Closing Date (as defined below). Subject to the terms hereof and of the LLC Agreement, the Subscriber&#8217;s obligation to make capital contributions hereunder shall be unconditional, complete and
binding upon the Closing Date (as defined below). </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">4.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B><U>Subsequent Commitments</U></B>. The Fund may, in its sole discretion, permit one or more investors to
make additional capital commitments (&#8220;<B><I>Subsequent Commitments</I></B>&#8221;). New investors that make a Subsequent Commitment, or existing unitholders of the Fund that increase their capital commitment (each, an &#8220;<B><I>Additional
Unitholder</I></B>&#8221;) will be required to make subsequent purchases of Units (each, a &#8220;<B><I><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-up</FONT> Purchase</I></B>&#8221;) on a date (or dates) (each such date, the &#8220;<B><I><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-up</FONT> Date</I></B>&#8221;) to be determined by the Fund. The aggregate amount of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-up</FONT> Purchase (the &#8220;<B><I><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-up</FONT>
Purchase Amount</I></B>&#8221;) will generally be equal to an amount necessary to ensure that, upon payment of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-up</FONT> Purchase Amount, such Additional Unitholder will have contributed the same percentage
of its capital commitment to the Fund as all unitholders whose subscriptions were previously accepted. Notwithstanding the foregoing, certain <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-up</FONT> Purchases may be made on a
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-pro</FONT> rata basis. <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-up</FONT> Purchases will be made at a per share price equal to the NAV per share as of the close of the last calendar quarter preceding the date of
the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-up</FONT> Purchase, subject to (i)&nbsp;adjustments as set forth below, (ii)&nbsp;as needed in order to comply with the requirements of Section&nbsp;23 of the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the
&#8220;<B><I>Investment Company Act</I></B>&#8221;), and (iii)&nbsp;further adjusted to appropriately reflect such Additional Unitholder&#8217;s pro rata portion of the Fund&#8217;s initial organizational expenses, if applicable. While an Additional
Unitholder will not know the Fund&#8217;s NAV applicable on the effective date of its <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-Up</FONT> Purchase, the Fund&#8217;s NAV applicable to a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-Up</FONT> Purchase will be
available after the close of the calendar quarter in which the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-Up</FONT> Purchase occurs; at that time, the number of shares based on that NAV and each Subscriber&#8217;s purchase will be determined and shares
will be credited to the Subscriber&#8217;s account as of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-Up</FONT> Date. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">5.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B><U>Drawdowns</U></B>. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">5.1.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">With respect to drawdowns by the Fund, each Subscriber will be required to fund drawdowns to purchase Units (a
&#8220;<B><I>Drawdown Purchase</I></B>&#8221;) up to the amount of their respective capital commitment each time the Fund delivers a notice (a &#8220;<B><I>Drawdown Notice</I></B>&#8221;). Drawdown Notices will specify (i)&nbsp;the amount of the
Drawdown (the &#8220;<B><I>Drawdown Amount</I></B>&#8221;); (ii) the portion of the Drawdown Amount to be paid by such Subscriber; (iii)&nbsp;the estimated number of Units to be purchased by such Subscriber; and (iv)&nbsp;the date (the
&#8220;<B><I>Drawdown Date</I></B>&#8221;) on which such Drawdown Amount is due. On the Drawdown Date, if, in connection with a per Unit price adjustment described in Section&nbsp;5.2 below, the number of Units to be purchased by a Subscriber
differs from the amount set forth in the Drawdown Notice, the Fund will deliver to the Subscriber an additional notice setting forth the actual number of Units to be purchased by such Subscriber. Drawdown Notices will be delivered to each Subscriber
at least 10 business days prior to the Drawdown Date (or shorter periods if the Adviser determines in good faith that it is necessary or appropriate to facilitate the consummation of a portfolio investment). All purchases pursuant to a Drawdown
Notice will generally be made pro rata, in accordance with the remaining capital commitments of all unitholders, however, certain Drawdown Purchases may be made on a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-pro</FONT> rata basis by unitholders that
provide capital commitments after the Fund&#8217;s initial closing. To accommodate the legal, tax, regulatory or fiscal concerns of certain prospective investors, the Fund may determine to allow certain investors to fully fund their capital
commitment at one point in time, in lieu of sequential drawdowns of the commitment as described in this Section&nbsp;5. No Subscriber shall be required to invest more than the total amount of its capital commitment. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">4 </P>

of the close of the last calendar quarter preceding the applicable Drawdown Date, subject to the board of directors of the Fund (the &#8220;<B><I>Board</I></B>&#8221;) or a committee thereof making a determination, no later than 48 hours (excluding
Sundays and holidays) prior to the Drawdown Date or the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-up</FONT> Date, as applicable, that the Fund is not selling Units at a price per Unit that is below its then-current net asset value per Unit.

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Each Drawdown Amount shall be payable in U.S. Dollars and in immediately available funds. Payment of a Drawdown
Amount shall be made on or prior to the applicable Drawdown Date and as promptly as possible after delivery of a Drawdown Notice. The delivery of a Drawdown Notice to the Subscriber shall be the sole and exclusive condition to its irrevocable and
unconditional obligation to pay the Drawdown Amount, without any right of offset, reduction, counterclaim or defense. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

Subscriber a number of Units equal to (i)&nbsp;the amount of such Drawdown Amount funded by the Subscriber on the applicable Drawdown Date divided by (ii)&nbsp;the price per Unit as determined above. For the avoidance of doubt, the Fund shall not
issue Units for any portion of the Subscriber&#8217;s capital commitment that has not been paid to the Fund and used to purchase Units pursuant to one or more Drawdown Notices (the &#8220;<B><I>Undrawn Commitment</I></B>&#8221;).

does not conflict with or result in any breach or violation of or default under the organizational documents governing the Fund, (ii)&nbsp;does not conflict with or result in any breach or

<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">6.4.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B><U>Term of the Fund</U></B>. The term of the Fund will be perpetual, meaning it will have an indefinite
duration and its units will be sold on a continuous basis at a price generally equal to the net asset value per unit (plus an amount equal to an allocable portion of its offering and organizational expenses). In the Fund&#8217;s perpetual life
cycle, the board of directors of the Fund, in its sole discretion, may elect to offer the Fund unitholders an opportunity to tender their Units, but it is not obligated to offer to repurchase any Units in any particular period. The Adviser, in its
commercially reasonable judgment and subject to market conditions, may recommend to the board of directors of the Fund (the &#8220;<B><I>Board</I></B>&#8221;) that the Fund&#8217;s commence quarterly repurchases in an amount not to exceed 5% of the
Fund&#8217;s NAV. Such recommendation is anticipated to occur no later than the second quarter of 2027. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

or the Offering Documents, the Fund shall have the right to exclude any Subscriber (such Subscriber, an &#8220;<B><I>Excluded Subscriber</I></B>&#8221;) from purchasing Units from the Fund on any date following the notice for capital contribution
(the &#8220;<B><I>Drawdown Date</I></B>,&#8221; as defined in Section&nbsp;6.1.2(a) of the LLC Agreement) if, in the reasonable discretion of the Fund, there is a substantial likelihood that such Subscriber&#8217;s purchase of Units at such time
would (i)&nbsp;result in a violation of, or noncompliance with, any law or regulation to which such Subscriber, the Fund, the Adviser, any Other Subscriber or a portfolio company would be subject or (ii)&nbsp;cause the investments of &#8220;Benefit
Plan Investors&#8221; (within the meaning of Section&nbsp;3(42) of the U.S. Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, as amended (&#8220;<B><I>ERISA</I></B>&#8221;) and certain Department of Labor regulations) to be significant and the assets
of the Fund to be considered &#8220;plan assets&#8221; under ERISA or Section&nbsp;4975 of the U.S. Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the &#8220;<B><I>Code</I></B>&#8221;). </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B><U>Evaluation and Ability to Bear Risks</U></B>. The Subscriber&#8217;s decision to invest in the Fund was
made by the Subscriber as person(s) who (a)&nbsp;are independent of the Fund and the Adviser and their respective affiliates, (b)&nbsp;are authorized to make such investment decisions, and (c)&nbsp;have relied on their own tax, legal and financial
advisers with regard to all matters relating to the Subscriber&#8217;s investment in the Fund (including federal, state and local tax matters) and not on any advice or recommendation of the Fund or the Adviser or any of their respective affiliates,
notwithstanding anything in Section&nbsp;7.3 to the contrary. The Subscriber&#8217;s prior investment experience and its general knowledge about the management, proposed operations and prospects of the Fund enable the Subscriber, together with the
Subscriber&#8217;s advisers, to make an informed decision with respect to the merits and risks of an investment in the Fund. After all necessary advice and analysis, the Subscriber has evaluated the risks of investing in Units and has determined
that the Units are a suitable investment for the Subscriber. The Subscriber has adequate means for providing for its current needs and other contingencies and has no need for liquidity with regards to its investment in Units, and is able to bear the
economic risk of its acquisition of Units, including a complete loss of its investment in the Fund. The Subscriber acknowledges and agrees that it is not a client of the Adviser and the Adviser is providing services solely to the Fund, including any
reporting or consultation with investors thereof. The Subscriber understands that at the time of the Subscriber&#8217;s investment, the Fund does not know in what portfolio investments the Fund will invest the Subscriber&#8217;s capital, and the
Fund will have complete control (subject to the provisions of the LLC Agreement) over the investments made by it. The Subscriber has not reproduced, duplicated or delivered the Offering Documents to any other person, except professional advisors to
the Subscriber or as instructed by the Fund. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

investment purposes only and not with a view to the resale or distribution of all or any portion of such Units and the Subscriber has no present intention, agreement or arrangement to divide its participation with others or to sell, assign, transfer
or otherwise dispose of, directly or indirectly, all or any portion of such Units. Each Subscriber agrees that if it determines to transfer or assign any of its Units in the Fund pursuant to the provisions hereof and of the LLC Agreement, it will
cause its proposed transferee to agree to the transfer restrictions and make the representations set forth herein. The Subscriber understands that it must bear the economic risk of its investment in Units for an indefinite period of time, because,
among other reasons, the offering and sale of Units has not been registered under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#8220;<B><I>Securities Act</I></B>&#8221;), or any state securities laws within the United States or the securities law of
any other jurisdiction, and therefore Units may not be resold or otherwise disposed of unless such sale or disposition is registered thereunder or an exemption from registration is available. The Subscriber also understands that the Fund is under no
obligation to register the Units on its behalf or to assist it in complying with any exemption from registration under the Securities Act. The Subscriber further understands that transfers of Units are further restricted by the provisions of the LLC
Agreement, by requirements imposed by the Fund&#8217;s creditor(s), and potentially by applicable state and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-U.S.</FONT> securities laws. No market exists or is expected to develop for the Units, the LLC Agreement

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">7.10.1.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">&#8220;Prohibited Investor&#8221; means (i)&nbsp;an individual, entity or organization that is the target of
the sanctions programs administered and enforced by the Office of Foreign Assets Control (&#8220;<B><I>OFAC</I></B>&#8221;) of the U.S. Department of the Treasury, including any person or entity named on OFAC&#8217;s Specially Designated Nationals
and Blocked Persons List, Foreign Sanctions Evaders List or Sectoral Sanctions Identifications List<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">1</SUP> or any other applicable sanctions laws;<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">2</SUP>
(ii)&nbsp;a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-U.S.</FONT> shell bank<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">3</SUP> or providing banking services indirectly to a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-U.S.</FONT> shell bank; (iii)&nbsp;a
senior <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-U.S.</FONT> political figure or an immediate family member or close associate<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">4</SUP> of such figure; or (iv)&nbsp;a party that the Fund is prohibited from
dealing with under applicable U.S. anti-money laundering, anti-terrorist and asset control laws, regulations, rules or orders. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">If the Subscriber is NOT acting on behalf of one or more clients, the Subscriber represents and warrants that
(a)&nbsp;neither it nor its authorized contact persons are Prohibited Investors, (b)&nbsp;it is a financial institution subject to the anti-money laundering (&#8220;<B><I>AML</I></B>&#8221;) program requirements of the USA PATRIOT Act and
(c)&nbsp;it has adopted and implemented AML programs required by the USA PATRIOT Act and the regulations promulgated thereunder.
</P></TD></TR></TABLE><DIV STYLE="line-height:8.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000;width:11%">&nbsp;</DIV>

is a person who is widely and publicly known (or is actually known) to be a close associate of a senior foreign political figure. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>Appendix A </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>TCW Customer Privacy Policy </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Effective
May 2025 </P> <P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV STYLE="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000">&nbsp;</DIV>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In this Privacy Policy, &#8220;TCW,&#8221; &#8220;we,&#8221; &#8220;us,&#8221;, and &#8220;our&#8221; refers collectively to The TCW Group, Inc. and its
subsidiaries, affiliates, and funds, including but not limited to, TCW Investment Management Company LLC, TCW Asset Management Company LLC, Metropolitan West Asset Management, LLC, TCW PT Management Company LLC, TCW Asset Backed Finance Management
Company LLC and Sepulveda Management LLC. References to the &#8220;Fund&#8221; refer to the particular investment fund(s) to which you are, or seek to be, admitted which are managed whether directly or indirectly by one or more investment manager,
and references to the &#8220;General Partner&#8221; refer to the general partner or similarly placed entity of such Fund. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">TCW recognizes the importance of
keeping information about you secure and confidential. We do not sell or share your nonpublic personal and financial information with marketers or others outside our affiliated group of companies. We carefully manage information among our affiliated
group of companies to safeguard your privacy. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The purpose of this Privacy Policy is to provide you with information about our use of Customer Data (as
defined below) in accordance with applicable privacy and data protection laws. </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV STYLE="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000">&nbsp;</DIV>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">If you are in the U.S., we are providing
this notice to you to comply with the requirements of Regulation <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">S-P,</FONT> &#8220;Privacy of Consumer Financial information,&#8221; issued by the United States Securities and Exchange Commission. This notice
specifically addresses nonpublic personal and financial information collected from our customers for the purposes of investment. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">If you are in the
European Economic Area (&#8220;EEA&#8221;) and the United Kingdom (collectively, the &#8220;EU&#8221;), we are providing this notice to you to comply with the requirements of applicable laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (the
&#8220;GDPR&#8221;), the UK Data Protection Act 2018 and the GDPR as it forms part of the law of England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland (the &#8220;UK GDPR&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Your personal information may be subject to certain additional and/or supplemental privacy notices depending on your location and your relationship with TCW.
If you are a TCW employee, a separate employee privacy notice has been provided to you. In addition, please review our online Privacy Policy, available at https://www.tcw.com/Privacy-Policy, for more information about how TCW collects, uses, and
shares information from visitors to the TCW website. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">19 </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right">APPENDIX A </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
<DIV STYLE="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000">&nbsp;</DIV>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">OUR PRIVACY POLICY </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We are committed to protecting the nonpublic
personal and financial information of our customers and consumers who obtain or seek to obtain financial products or services primarily for personal, family or household purposes. We fulfill our commitment by establishing and implementing policies
and systems to protect the security and confidentiality of this information. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In our offices, we limit access to nonpublic personal and financial
information about you to those TCW personnel who need to know the information in order to provide products or services to you. We maintain physical, electronic, and procedural safeguards to protect your nonpublic personal and financial information;
however, no method of transmission or electronic storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV STYLE="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000">&nbsp;</DIV>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">CATEGORIES OF INFORMATION WE COLLECT </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;Customer Data&#8221;
means personal data that reasonably can be associated or linked to you or another customer as an individual person, and includes nonpublic personal and financial information, as well as personal data on yourself that you provide to us, as well as
the personal data of individuals connected with you as an investor (for example, directors, trustees, employees, representatives, shareholders, investors, clients, beneficial owners or agents). In our use of Customer Data, the Fund, the General
Partner and the investment manager are each characterized as a &#8220;controller&#8221; under the GDPR and the UK GDPR. Except as otherwise described in this Privacy Policy, the affiliates and delegates of the Fund, the General Partner and the
investment manager may act as &#8220;processors&#8221; of Customer Data. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">If you are a natural person, this Privacy Policy will affect you directly. If
you are a corporate investor (including, for these purposes, legal arrangements such as trusts or exempted limited partnerships) that provides us with Customer Data on individuals connected to you for any reason in relation to your investment with
us, this will be relevant for those individuals and you should transmit this document to those individuals or otherwise advise them of its content. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We
collect and process the following forms of Customer Data: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Identifiers such as your name, residential and/or business address, mailing address, email address, personal
and/or business contact information, proof of address, driver&#8217;s license, tax identification number, social security (or national insurance or similar) number, and passport number and other government identification information and/or numbers.
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">opt-out</FONT> provisions. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV STYLE="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000">&nbsp;</DIV>

required or permitted by law. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV STYLE="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000">&nbsp;</DIV>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">INTERNATIONAL DATA TRANSFERS </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Because the internet and our
operations are global, Customer Data may be transferred to, processed in, and held in countries (including the United States) other than the one in which you reside. The EEA and the UK do not consider the United States and many other countries to
provide essentially equivalent privacy protections. Such transfers are a necessary part of the services that we provide. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We will ensure application of
the same standards of privacy protection as set out in this Privacy Policy regardless of the international transfer or processing of Customer Data. To the extent required by, and in accordance with, applicable data protection laws, we rely on
appropriate or suitable safeguards in respect of international transfers of Customer Data, including: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Using standard contractual clauses approved by relevant authorities as ensuring adequate safeguards.
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Obtaining your consent to transfer Customer Data about you after first informing you about the possible risks of
such a transfer. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

necessary for the performance of a contract between us and a third party, and the contract was entered into in your interest. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">HOW LONG DO WE RETAIN CUSTOMER DATA? </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We retain Customer Data
only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy, subject to your rights, under certain circumstances, to have your Customer Data erased. When deciding how long to retain Customer Data, we take into account our legal
and regulatory obligations, the amount, nature and sensitivity of the Customer Data, the potential risk of harm from unauthorized use or disclosure of Customer Data, the purposes for which we process Customer Data and whether we can achieve those
purposes through other means. We may also retain Customer Data to investigate or defend against potential legal claims in accordance with the limitation periods of countries where legal action may be brought. </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV STYLE="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000">&nbsp;</DIV>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Individuals in the EEA and the UK, and
individuals in other jurisdictions whose Customer Data is subject to the GDPR and/or the UK GDPR, have certain rights in relation to their Customer Data. Subject to certain limitations, these rights include the right for individuals to:
(i)&nbsp;request access to and rectification or erasure of their Customer Data; (ii)&nbsp;restrict or object to the processing of their Customer Data; and (iii)&nbsp;obtain a copy of their Customer Data in a portable format. Individuals may also
have the right to lodge a complaint about the processing of Customer Data with a data protection or supervisory authority. </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV STYLE="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000">&nbsp;</DIV>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">QUESTIONS </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Should you have any questions about our Customer
Privacy Policy, please contact us by email or by regular mail at the address at the end of this policy. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Individuals in some U.S. jurisdictions, including
California, have certain data subject rights. These rights vary, but they may include the right to: (i)&nbsp;request access to and rectification or erasure of their personal data; (ii)&nbsp;restrict or object to the processing of their personal
data; and (iii)&nbsp;obtain a copy of their personal data in a portable format. Individuals may also have the right to lodge a complaint about the processing of personal data with a data protection authority. If you wish to exercise any of these
rights please contact us by email or by regular mail at the address at the end of this policy. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>Appendix B </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>List of &#8220;Bad Acts&#8221; </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">For purposes of Section&nbsp;7.13 of the Subscription Agreement to which this document is appended, a person described in such paragraph shall have committed
a &#8220;Bad Act&#8221; if any of the following is true with respect to such person: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i)&nbsp;Has been convicted, within ten years before such sale (or
five years, in the case of issuers, their predecessors and affiliated issuers), of any felony or misdemeanor: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(A)&nbsp;In connection with
the purchase or sale of any security; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(B)&nbsp;Involving the making of any false filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
(the &#8220;<B><I>Commission</I></B>&#8221;); or </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(C)&nbsp;Arising out of the conduct of the business of an underwriter, broker, dealer,
municipal securities dealer, investment adviser or paid solicitor of purchasers of securities; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii)&nbsp;Is subject to any order, judgment or decree of
any court of competent jurisdiction, entered within five years before such sale, that, at the time of such sale, restrains or enjoins such person from engaging or continuing to engage in any conduct or practice: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(A)&nbsp;In connection with the purchase or sale of any security; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(B)&nbsp;Involving the making of any false filing with the Commission; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(C)&nbsp;Arising out of the conduct of the business of an underwriter, broker, dealer, municipal securities dealer, investment adviser or paid
solicitor of purchasers of securities; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii)&nbsp;Is subject to a final order of a state securities commission (or an agency or officer of a state
performing like functions); a state authority that supervises or examines banks, savings associations, or credit unions; a state insurance commission (or an agency or officer of a state performing like functions); an appropriate federal banking
agency; the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission; or the National Credit Union Administration that: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(A)&nbsp;At the time of such
sale, bars the person from: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(1)&nbsp;Association with an entity regulated by such commission, authority, agency, or officer; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(2)&nbsp;Engaging in the business of securities, insurance or banking; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(3)&nbsp;Engaging in savings association or credit union activities; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(B)&nbsp;Constitutes a final order based on a violation of any law or regulation that prohibits fraudulent, manipulative, or deceptive conduct
entered within ten years before such sale; </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">27 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iv)&nbsp;Is subject to an order of the Commission entered pursuant to Section&nbsp;15(b) or 15B(c) of the
Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 U.S.C. 78o(b) or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">78o-4(c))</FONT> or Section&nbsp;203(e) or (f)&nbsp;of the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 (15 U.S.C. <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">80b-3(e)</FONT> or (f))
that, at the time of such sale: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(A)&nbsp;Suspends or revokes such person&#8217;s registration as a broker, dealer, municipal securities
dealer or investment adviser; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(B)&nbsp;Places limitations on the activities, functions or operations of such person; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(C)&nbsp;Bars such person from being associated with any entity or from participating in the offering of any penny stock; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(v)&nbsp;Is subject to any order of the Commission entered within five years before such sale that, at the time of such sale, orders the person to cease and
desist from committing or causing a violation or future violation of: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(A)&nbsp;Any scienter-based anti-fraud provision of the federal
securities laws, including without limitation Section&nbsp;17(a)(1) of the Securities Act of 1933 (15 U.S.C. 77q(a)(1)), Section&nbsp;10(b) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 U.S.C. 78j(b)) and 17 CFR
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">240.10b-5,</FONT> Section&nbsp;15(c)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 U.S.C. 78o(c)(1)) and Section&nbsp;206(1) of the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 (15 U.S.C.
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">80b-6(1)),</FONT> or any other rule or regulation thereunder; or </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(B)&nbsp;Section 5 of the Securities Act
of 1933 (15 U.S.C. 77e). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(vi)&nbsp;Is suspended or expelled from membership in, or suspended or barred from association with a member of, a registered
national securities exchange or a registered national or affiliated securities association for any act or omission to act constituting conduct inconsistent with just and equitable principles of trade; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(vii)&nbsp;Has filed (as a registrant or issuer), or was or was named as an underwriter in, any registration statement or Regulation A offering statement filed
with the Commission that, within five years before such sale, was the subject of a refusal order, stop order, or order suspending the Regulation&nbsp;A exemption, or is, at the time of such sale, the subject of an investigation or proceeding to
determine whether a stop order or suspension order should be issued; or </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(viii)&nbsp;Is subject to a United States Postal Service false representation
order entered within five years before such sale, or is, at the time of such sale, subject to a temporary restraining order or preliminary injunction with respect to conduct alleged by the United States Postal Service to constitute a scheme or
device for obtaining money or property through the mail by means of false representations. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">If the Subscriber has been subject to such an event but, prior
to the date hereof, (i)&nbsp;the court or regulatory authority that entered the relevant order, judgment or decree has advised in writing (whether contained in the relevant judgment, order or decree or separately to the Commission or its staff) that
disqualification under paragraph (d)(1) of Rule 506 under the Securities Act should not arise as a consequence of such order, judgment or decree or (ii)&nbsp;the Commission has issued an exemption from paragraph (d)(1) of Rule 506 with respect to
such event, a copy of such order, judgment, decree or exemption is attached to this certificate. </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>PART B: Status as Benefit Plan Investor </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>(a) <U>Overview.</U> </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The ERISA Plan
Asset Regulation defines &#8220;<B><I>Benefit Plan Investor</I></B>&#8221;<I> </I>as: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) any employee benefit plan subject to Part&nbsp;4
of Subtitle&nbsp;B of Title&nbsp;I of ERISA; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) any plan to which Section&nbsp;4975 of the Code applies (which includes a trust
described in Section&nbsp;401(a) of the Code that is exempt from tax under Section&nbsp;501(a) of the Code, a plan described in Section&nbsp;403(a) of the Code, an individual retirement account or annuity described in Section&nbsp;408 or&nbsp;408A
of the Code, a medical savings account described in Section&nbsp;220(d) of the Code, a health savings account described in Section&nbsp;223(d) of the Code and an education savings account described in Section&nbsp;530 of the Code); or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) a person or entity whose underlying assets include, or are deemed to include under the ERISA Plan Asset Regulation or otherwise for
purposes of Part&nbsp;4 of Subtitle&nbsp;B of Title&nbsp;I of ERISA or Section&nbsp;4975 of the Code, &#8220;plan assets&#8221; by reason of an investment in the person or entity by plans described in (a)(i) or (a)(ii) immediately above. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">A person or entity described in (a)(iii) immediately above will be considered to hold &#8220;plan assets&#8221; only to the extent of the
percentage of the equity interests in the person or entity held by plans described in (a)(i) and (a)(ii) immediately above. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>If the
Subscriber is a Benefit Plan Investor as described above, please notify the Fund. Please note that a Benefit Plan Investor includes IRAs and HSAs. </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>(b)</B> <B><U>Individual Retirement Accounts and Health Savings Accounts.</U></B> If the Subscriber is investing as a trustee or custodian for an IRA or an
HSA, is Subscriber a qualified IRA or HSA custodian or trustee? If yes, the Acknowledgement by IRA/HSA Custodian or Trustee with Respect to Investment for an IRA/HSA on the signature page must be completed. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:50%; text-indent:-2%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#9744; &#8195;&#8195;Yes </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:50%; text-indent:-2%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#9744; &#8195;&#8195;No </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:50%; text-indent:-2%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#9744; &#8195;&#8195;Not Applicable </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>Again, please notify the Fund if the Subscriber is investing on behalf of an IRA or an HSA as described above. </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>(c)</B> <B><U>ERISA Controlling Person.</U></B> Does the Subscriber, or any &#8220;affiliate&#8221; of the Subscriber, have discretionary authority or
control with respect to the assets of the Fund or provide investment advice for a fee (direct or indirect) with respect to the Fund&#8217;s assets (an &#8220;<B><I>ERISA</I></B> <B><I>Controlling Person</I></B>&#8221;). For purposes of this ERISA
Controlling Person representation, an &#8220;affiliate&#8221; is defined in paragraph&nbsp;(f)(3) of the ERISA Plan Asset Regulation as any person or entity, directly or indirectly, through one or more intermediaries, controlling, controlled by or
under common control with such person. &#8220;Control&#8221; with respect to a person other than an individual means the power to exercise a controlling influence over the management or policies of such person. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">I-8 </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ANNEX I TO THE SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT </U></B></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>2.</B> <B><U>Subscriber&#8217;s Net Worth.</U></B><B><I> (Please indicate whether the following representation is applicable by checking the appropriate
box.)</I></B><I> </I>The Subscriber (or the grantor, in the case of a grantor trust) is a natural person whose individual net worth, or joint net worth<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">2</SUP> with that person&#8217;s spouse or spousal
equivalent<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">3</SUP>, at the time of subscription exceeds $1,000,000 or had an individual income in excess of $200,000 in each of the two most recent years or joint income with the Subscriber&#8217;s
spouse or spousal equivalent of $300,000 in each of those years and the Subscriber has a reasonable expectation of reaching the same income level in the current year.<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">4</SUP> When calculating the
Subscriber&#8217;s net worth for the purpose of this question, the </P><DIV STYLE="line-height:8.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000;width:11%">&nbsp;</DIV>

agreement. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">2</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">For purposes of this Subscription Agreement, the Subscriber&#8217;s spouse or spousal equivalent does not need
to hold assets jointly with the Subscriber for the Subscriber to include such amounts in the calculation of total assets in determining the Subscriber&#8217;s net worth. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ELECTRONIC COMMUNICATION AND SIGNATURE AUTHORIZATION </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">By acknowledging your consent below (and as long as you provide us with an electronic mail address) you consent to any and all authorized
contacts receiving electronic communications and understand that no paper copy will follow by mail. You agree that the authorized contacts listed in the Subscription Agreement (and any others you may subsequently identify) are specified as your
agents for the limited purpose of receiving, on your behalf, any electronic delivery including, but not limited to, account statements, performance reports, privacy notices, investment adviser brochures (Form ADV), disclosure documents and any other
information delivered or provided (i)&nbsp;by the TCW Specialty Lending LLC, TCW Asset Management Company LLC or any of their Affiliates (collectively, &#8220;<B><I>TCW</I></B>&#8221;) in connection with the investment advisory services that TCW
provides to investors and (ii)&nbsp;by any other agent of TCW. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">You further agree to notify TCW promptly in writing of any change to an <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> or any other electronic delivery address specified above or otherwise agreed between you and TCW. Until we have received notice of a change, we may continue to send information to the previous <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> or other electronic address, and any such information will be deemed to have been delivered, whether or not it is actually received. Additionally, you acknowledge and agree by acknowledging your consent below
that a successful transmission report received by TCW will constitute delivery of any communication. At your request, we will send you paper copies of any information we make available in electronic form. You may request paper copies by contacting
the Fund at PrivateFunds@tcw.com. You agree, however, that neither your request for, nor our deliver of, a paper copy will imply that the previous electronic delivery of the information did not constitute good and effective delivery. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Although TCW will take all appropriate measures to protect the confidentiality of any information transmitted through <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail,</FONT> please be advised that the facility to encrypt <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> messages is not available. Furthermore, the internet is not a secure environment and the use of Internet <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> carries with it a number of inherent risks. As a result, we cannot guarantee that <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> will be delivered within a reasonable time or at all; that <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> comes from the purported sender; that <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> is not intercepted by unauthorized or unintended third parties; that the content of the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> is unaltered from the time of transmission and therefore we cannot guarantee the accuracy or completeness of the information; or that the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> sent by us will
be free from viruses. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">You are responsible for having any necessary hardware, software or other technology to access electronic
communication. By acknowledging your consent below you acknowledge and agree that you are aware of and accept the risks associated with internet <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> and that the Fund&#8217;s agents, TCW, their respective
Affiliates and each of their respective partners, employees and agents will have no liability, contingent or otherwise, to you or any third party arising from or in any way related to the use of electronic communication. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Please note that we cannot accept instructions of any kind, including notices of capital contributions, sent through email. </P>

(&#8220;<B><I>PDF</I></B>&#8221;), or other file formats we deem appropriate. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>(</B><B><I>Please acknowledge your consent by checking

<TD VALIGN="bottom" STYLE="BORDER-TOP:1px solid #000000; BORDER-BOTTOM:1px solid #000000;"><B>Certification</B></TD></TR>
</TABLE>
<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" WIDTH="100%" BORDER="0" STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:8pt" ALIGN="center">

<TD WIDTH="99%"></TD>

<TD VALIGN="bottom" WIDTH="1%"></TD>
<TD></TD>
<TD></TD>
<TD></TD></TR>


<TR STYLE="page-break-inside:avoid ; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">
<TD VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE="font-size:2pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Under penalties of perjury, I certify that:</P>
<P STYLE="font-size:2pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1.50em; text-indent:-1.50em; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.&#8194;&#8201;The number shown on this form is
my correct taxpayer identification number (or I am waiting for a number to be issued to me); and</P> <P STYLE="font-size:2pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1.50em; text-indent:-1.50em; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.&#8194;&#8201;I am not subject to backup withholding because (a) I am exempt from backup withholding, or (b) I have
not been notified by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) that I am subject to backup withholding as a result of a failure to report all interest or dividends, or (c) the IRS has notified me that I am no longer subject to backup withholding; and</P>
<P STYLE="font-size:2pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1.50em; text-indent:-1.50em; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.&#8194;&#8201;I am a U.S. citizen or other U.S.
person (defined below); and</P> <P STYLE="font-size:2pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1.50em; text-indent:-1.50em; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.&#8194;&#8201;The FATCA code(s) entered on this form (if any) indicating that I am exempt from FATCA reporting is
correct.</P> <P STYLE="font-size:4pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:1pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Certification instructions.</B> You must cross out item 2 above if you
have been notified by the IRS that you are currently subject to backup withholding because you have failed to report all interest and dividends on your tax return. For real estate transactions, item 2 does not apply. For mortgage interest paid,
acquisition or abandonment of secured property, cancellation of debt, contributions to an individual retirement arrangement (IRA), and, generally, payments other than interest and dividends, you are not required to sign the certification, but you
must provide your correct TIN. See the instructions for Part II, later.</P></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom">&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom"></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom"></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom"></TD></TR>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>General Instructions </B></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:2pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:7pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Future developments</B>. For the latest information about developments related to Form W-9 and its instructions, such as legislation enacted after they were
published, go to <I>www.irs.gov/FormW9</I>. </P></DIV><DIV STYLE="position:relative;float:left; margin-left:3%; width:49%;padding-right:0%;padding-bottom:8pt;overflow:visible;padding-top:3pt">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>What&#8217;s New </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:7pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Line 3a has been modified to clarify how a disregarded entity completes this line. An LLC that is a disregarded entity should check the appropriate box for the
tax classification of its owner. Otherwise, it should check the &#8220;LLC&#8221; box and enter its appropriate tax classification.

<TD VALIGN="top"><FONT STYLE="font-size:7pt">Form W-9 (Rev. 3-2024)</FONT></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD VALIGN="top" ALIGN="right"><FONT STYLE="font-size:7pt">Page</FONT></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD VALIGN="top" ALIGN="right"><B>2</B></TD></TR></TABLE> <DIV STYLE="line-height:3.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000">&nbsp;</DIV>
<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV STYLE="position:relative;float:left; width:48%;padding-right:0%;padding-bottom:8pt;overflow:visible;padding-top:3pt">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:3%; font-size:7pt; font-family:Times New Roman">New line 3b has been added to this form. A flow-through entity is required to complete this line
to indicate that it has direct or indirect foreign partners, owners, or beneficiaries when it provides the Form W-9 to another flow-through entity in which it has an ownership interest. This change is intended to provide a flow-through entity with
information regarding the status of its indirect foreign partners, owners, or beneficiaries, so that it can satisfy any applicable reporting requirements. For example, a partnership that has any indirect foreign partners may be required to complete
Schedules K-2 and K-3. See the Partnership Instructions for Schedules K-2 and K-3 (Form 1065). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:4pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Purpose of Form </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:7pt; font-family:Times New Roman">An individual or entity (Form W-9 requester) who is required to file an information return with the IRS is giving you this form because they must obtain your
correct taxpayer identification number (TIN), which may be your social security number (SSN), individual taxpayer identification number (ITIN), adoption taxpayer identification number (ATIN), or employer identification number (EIN), to report on an
information return the amount paid to you, or other amount reportable on an information return. Examples of information returns include, but are not limited to, the following. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:2pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
